system.description:
When using this skill, you may spend up to three [Fate Points] (0 is okay). The target takes [Weakness] with a rating equal to [(Spent [Fate Points] + SR) x 2].

(CR11): The multiplier bonus becomes x4.
(CR21): The multiplier bonus becomes x6.

A special skill that attacks in conjunction with summoned creatures. A perfect combination inflicts even more damage on the enemy.
